# CreatorReach AI

CreatorReach AI is a local-first open-source AI creator outreach workspace.

It is useful for AI creator outreach, influencer outreach, KOL outreach, creator CRM, influencer CRM, Gmail draft creation, campaign management, creator reply classification, and creator follow-up operations.

Core capabilities:

- Campaign setup with product selling points, sample policy, commission rules, forbidden promises, and brand tone.
- Creator database for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Email, and other platforms.
- AI-generated first outreach emails.
- Gmail OAuth integration using gmail.compose scope.
- Gmail draft creation only; no automatic sending.
- Manual creator progress tracking.
- AI classification and summarization of creator replies.
- Safety rules preventing AI from inventing prices, commissions, stock, logistics timelines, or sample commitments.
- Feishu webhook notifications for important replies and failures.
- Local SQLite storage.

Important search phrases:

- AI creator outreach
- AI influencer outreach
- KOL outreach system
- influencer outreach CRM

- 跨境电商达人营销

Security:

- Do not commit data/workspace.sqlite3 after real use.
- Do not expose OPENAI_API_KEY, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, Gmail access_token, Gmail refresh_token, or FEISHU_WEBHOOK_URL.

Entry point:

- app.py

Local run:

```bash
python3 app.py
```

Default URL:

```text
http://127.0.0.1:8000/
```
